name: inprocess-obi-apb-cv32e20-irqadapter-timer-zipdma-f1f6
notes: P0-1 CPU replacement: the same target, DMA, windows, image and records as the Ibex declaration; only cpu_profile changes. This variant is not used by any other inprocess scenario: it elaborates cve2_top with RVFI=1 (cve2_top_tracing) and carries the cv32e20_native_irq_receipts.v1 evidence, so its IRQ acceptance is the real controller decision plus irq_ack/id, not an inference from a fetch.
description: The Ibex timer/ZipDMA declaration with the CPU replaced by the pinned cv32e20_profile_irq_adapter model (CVE2 elaborated with RVFI=1 and the native IRQ receipt adapter). Only the cpu_profile line differs from inprocess-obi-apb-ibex-timer-zipdma-f1f6.json.
